Definition: from G3844 and G134; to mispraise, i.e. recommend or advise (a different course):--admonish, exhort.
BiblicalUsage: Paraineō means to advise, to exhort, to recommend. Paul advises the centurion that the voyage will be with hurt and much damage, and later he exhorts them to be of good cheer, for there shall be no loss of any man's life among you.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul's advice shows what a prisoner can be: ignored at first, then the only voice of good cheer on a sinking ship.
